styles.name: Toile de Jouy
styles.text: Blue on cream. A garden with a fountain and a pavilion, a spaniel at rest and cats at play.
styles.toppers: two songbirds, an urn of flowers

styles.name: Chinoiserie
styles.text: A sage green garden of blossom and bamboo, with a pagoda, a pug and a ginger cat.
styles.toppers: a bird, a peony, a butterfly

styles.name: Art Deco
styles.text: Gold on dark green. A great fan, two leaping greyhounds and a seated cat.

styles.name: Botanical
styles.text: Ferns, hellebore and ivy on a cream ground, drawn like a plate from an old herbarium.
styles.toppers: a leaf sprig, a fern, a small bird

styles.name: Woodblock
styles.text: A Japanese print: the great wave, Mount Fuji, and a shiba with a cat on the shore.
styles.toppers: a crane, a pine, a red sun

styles.name: Grand Tour
styles.text: A 1930s travel poster: a grand hotel on a lake, with a terrier and a cat on the terrace.
styles.toppers: a sun, a pine tree, a sailing boat
